title: Guest speaker
passage: Who is introducing the guest speaker? A. I can do it if nobody else has volunteered. B. An introduction to accounting. C. The speaker system is new.
passageZh:
誰要介紹客座講者？
A. 如果還沒有人自願，我可以。
B. 會計入門。
C. 擴音系統是新的。
